description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateClientCommandHandler' that handles update commands for client entities within the Fineract microfinance platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is responsible for processing update commands by invoking the 'ClientWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: UpdateClientCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for client entities, processing commands by delegating to the ClientWritePlatformService.

methods.name: UpdateClientCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to update a client by calling the updateClient method of ClientWritePlatformService.
